title: Settings and instructions: the policy helper's claudeMd tier
status: implementation and main verification; one bounded independent review pending
sourceBehaviour: lr() returns the helper state output unless it was armed from remote; M2n() returns that output's claudeMd or null.
qZn pushes the helper block as {path:EEo,type:"Managed",content:bn} only when the text is truthy, between the managed directory's own file and the settings document's claudeMd.

zt() fingerprints policySettings.claudeMd, M2n(), claudeMdExcludes, autoMemoryEnabled, env and ir(); Jt re-evaluates it and on a change calls gk(e) and Cx(e,"policy_refresh"), clearing the cached userContext so the next prompt is rebuilt.
The static default fallback output is {managedSettings:...} only, so the default tier supplies no instruction text.
hostAdaptations: managedHelperSchema is the strict managed-policy schema plus claudeMd; the CLI and policyHelper.defaultPolicy validate with it.
loadProjectConfig and loadChildInstructions insert policyHelperText under <policyHelper> after the managed directory's files and before the settings document's claudeMd.
refreshPolicyHelperInstructions rewrites the once-built prompt section in place, keeps memory blocks, and journals policyHelperText; the CLI settle calls it after every helper refresh.
Only the helper tier supplies text (serving === 'helper'); the static default payload's claudeMd is not used.

applyManagedPolicy now rebuilds the policySettings permission layer from the applied policy, and the settle re-seeds the live permission owner with reloadPermissionState; this repaired a defect that left the startup managed policy in force (the W08 driver's served case was red at the W369 commit).

validation.redBaseline: compiled CLI before the change: {claudeMd:...} was refused with 'policy does not match the managed policy schema' and the request lacked the text; the served case was also denied because the stale policySettings layer stayed in force

defectsRepaired: applyManagedPolicy replaced the managed base fields but kept the previous policySettings permission layer, and the live permission owner kept the rules seeded at open, so a helper document's policy never replaced the startup managed policy. The layer is now rebuilt from the applied policy and the settle re-seeds the owner with reloadPermissionState.
knownLimitations: A config without instructionSources cannot distinguish a memory block from instruction text; the live CLI, reload and every child build set the list.
The static default payload's own claudeMd is not used for instructions, matching the recovered default output.
The helper text is refreshed only through the CLI settle, reload and child builds; a host embedding that mutates config.system directly bypasses it.
notPorted: the remote-armed helper state (armedFromRemote; remote managed policy is External)

boundaries: No account, subscription, OAuth or network feature; the helper reads a local file only.
